description: Dynamically constructs and injects the correct authentication header into the outbound HTTP request before it is sent to the adapter's API. Supports all auth types used in the adapter catalog: API key (header injection), OAuth2 (bearer token exchange), basic auth (base64 username:password), and bearer token (direct injection). Works in conjunction with credential_resolve_hook which has already resolved raw credential values into memory. Blocks the adapter call from proceeding until authorization is successfully injected. Prevents any API call from being sent without a valid auth header.
use_cases: Injecting API key header for GSTN, Karza, and Razorpay adapters
Building OAuth2 bearer token headers for CIBIL and Perfios
Base64 encoding credentials for Razorpay and Twilio basic auth
Injecting bearer token for RiskGuard internal APIs
Dynamic auth header construction based on adapter auth_type
when_to_use: Attach to all adapters that require authentication. Runs after credential_resolve_hook and before field_encryption_hook and outbound call.
trigger_condition: Before outbound adapter HTTP call, after credential resolution

input_parameters.description: Auth type: api_key, oauth2, bearer_token, or basic_auth
Environment variable name holding the credential
HTTP headers object for the outbound request

output.on_success: request_headers enriched with Authorization header injected
output.on_failure: Pipeline aborted for this adapter; HOOK_001 logged

error_codes.HOOK_001: Missing or invalid credentials for auth injection.
error_codes.HOOK_003: Attempted to send request without auth header.
